svg.title: makemycv.ae icon
svg.desc: Twin ascending peaks that also read as an M: a cream peak and a taller gold peak on a navy rounded square. Every slope uses the same 58 degree system angle, separated by a constant-width negative gap. Icon master (2026-08 reskin): the tile carries a subtle vertical navy gradient plus a faint top light echoing the site's 3D-glass language, and the mark is scaled 1.12x for legibility at 16px. Same brand navy/cream/gold as the lockup SVGs in public/logos/.
